# fct_room_rates

`data-warehouse-359101.analytics.fct_room_rates` · dbt area: `portal`

Fact table of individual rates returned for a rate request, with the canonical room each rate maps to. Each row represents a single rate returned for a hotel on a request.

| Column | Description |
|---|---|
| `room_rate_key` | Primary Key. Composite key combining request_id, supplier_id, and source_rate_identifier to uniquely identify each rate returned for a hotel on a request. >> SOURCE - Portal data_tests: - unique - not_null |
| `advisor_uuid` | Foreign Key. Unique identifier for the advisor who made the rate request. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `canonical_room_id` | Foreign Key to dim_canonical_rooms. Null when the rate has no active room mapping. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `check_in_date` | Check-in date for the stay of the requested rate. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `check_out_date` | Check-out date for the stay of the requested rate. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `commission_percent` | Commission % on the rate. Where the feed returns 0 on a rate marked as commissionable, we assume 10% per Fora's confirmed standard. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `count_adults` | Number of adults in the rate request. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `count_children` | Number of children in the rate request. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `count_nights` | Number of nights calculated from check-in and check-out dates. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `count_rooms` | Number of rooms requested. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `grand_total_price_usd` | Grand total price of the rate in USD. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_commissionable` | True/false flag indicating whether the rate is commissionable. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_rate_visible_in_portal` | True/false flag indicating whether the rate is visible in the portal. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `is_refundable` | True/false flag indicating whether the rate is refundable. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `program_name` | The rate program returned by the provider, as-is from the feed. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `rate_description` | Rate plan description for the rate (e.g. 'Flexible Rate - Free Cancellation'). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `rate_provider` | The rate provider that returned the rate (e.g. Travelport). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `rate_requested_at` | Timestamp when the rate request was made. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `request_id` | Identifier for the rate request. A request can return rates for multiple suppliers. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `room_description` | Human-readable room description for the rate (e.g. 'King Deluxe Ocean View'). >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `source_rate_identifier` | The rate code returned by the provider. Not globally unique; an be reused across hotels. >> SOURCE - Portal |
| `supplier_id` | Foreign Key. Unique identifier for the supplier (hotel) the rate is for. >> SOURCE - Portal |
